affected.product: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint for Windows

descriptions.value: Out-of-bounds read in Microsoft Defender allows an authorized attacker to disclose information locally.

Improper input validation for some Media Transcode Accelerator before version 1.0.0-00128 within Ring 3: User Applications may allow a denial of service. System software adversary with a privileged user combined with a high complexity attack may enable denial of service. This result may potentially occur via local access when attack requirements are not present without special internal knowledge and requires no user interaction. The potential vulnerability may impact the confidentiality (none), integrity (none) and availability (high) of the vulnerable system, resulting in subsequent system confidentiality (none), integrity (none) and availability (none) impacts.
Missing authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
